proposed_manuscript_claim: The study has two coequal empirical modules: LinkUp demand and Revelio actual entry/reallocation.
evidence_needed: Frozen two-source contract; completed inputs for both modules
current_evidence: Plan §11 sets a roughly 50/50 contribution target; Revelio files/schema are unavailable.
allowed_wording: The design targets approximately equal research contribution by the two sources.
prohibited_wording: Both sources have already contributed equal empirical evidence.
next_gate: R0 must verify real Revelio files schema and person-frame sampling.

proposed_manuscript_claim: LinkUp observes job-ad requirement text for a bounded candidate frame.
evidence_needed: Versioned ad-level sample frame; inclusion probabilities; text evidence
current_evidence: Old C1 has 69 common cells, 10075 AI-use candidates and a defined 3:1 capped control draw; new production not run.
allowed_wording: The planned LinkUp estimand is the old candidate frame after one bounded remeasurement.
prohibited_wording: The sample represents all AI jobs or all job postings.
next_gate: L1 sample manifest and L2/L3 outputs.

proposed_manuscript_claim: The LinkUp text is a contemporaneous hiring-demand panel.
evidence_needed: Independent text-version dates or historical snapshots
current_evidence: CREATED is first observation; old report says saved text can have mixed vintages.
allowed_wording: Current snapshot text mixed vintages; CREATED is used for cohorting and stratification only.
prohibited_wording: A CREATED-quarter requirement was faced by same-quarter entrants.

proposed_manuscript_claim: GenAI and traditional-software jobs differ in measured experience requirements.
evidence_needed: Frozen role-confirmed groups; evidence-backed four-object extraction; evaluation and review receipts
current_evidence: Old C1 candidate comparison exists, but general/industry/tool are limited candidates, occupation/task is NA, and new role/experience extraction is not run.
allowed_wording: Old C1 differences are diagnostic properties of frozen candidate measures, not the new main estimate.
prohibited_wording: AI changes the experience requirement or lowers the skill threshold.
next_gate: L2-L5, including evaluation thresholds and blind review.

proposed_manuscript_claim: Predictive-AI requirements are absent from job ads.
evidence_needed: A measure that can detect predictive-AI applicant context
current_evidence: Existing zero is structural under applicant-context gating.
allowed_wording: Predictive-AI is unavailable under the frozen applicant-context measure.
next_gate: New valid extraction route with evidence audit.

proposed_manuscript_claim: General work experience is observed comprehensively in old tables.
current_evidence: Old measure matches only a narrow explicit object; unspecified object is not its complement.
allowed_wording: The old general-work flag is a narrow explicit-object candidate measure.
prohibited_wording: The old rate is the prevalence of transferable experience requirements.

proposed_manuscript_claim: CPS measures computer adoption or workplace computer use.
evidence_needed: CPS computer-use variable and documented construction
current_evidence: Existing benchmark uses fixed Autor-Dorn RTI; report says no workplace computer-use field was analyzed.
allowed_wording: CPS provides a descriptive occupational-composition benchmark using fixed RTI.
prohibited_wording: Computer adoption rose or fell by the reported CPS amount.
next_gate: A separately documented computer-use dataset and design.

proposed_manuscript_claim: The CPS benchmark reconstructs the early computer revolution.
evidence_needed: Pre-2004 comparable data and historical identification design
allowed_wording: It is a later-period descriptive benchmark, not a reconstruction of the 1980s-1990s transition.
prohibited_wording: The benchmark estimates the causal effect of computerization.

proposed_manuscript_claim: AI beta is a usable historical technology measure.
evidence_needed: Actual mapping receipt; shared occupation crosswalk; year and definition audit
current_evidence: No actual mapping receipt located in this round.
allowed_wording: AI beta is unverified and excluded from frozen main analysis.
prohibited_wording: AI beta is available because a planned variable has that name.
next_gate: G1 mapping receipt and compatibility decision.

proposed_manuscript_claim: Revelio measures prior experience before occupational entry.
evidence_needed: Actual schema; stable person/position IDs; event dates; complete visible histories
current_evidence: REVELIO_INTERFACE is design-complete and explicitly says schema unverified/no data processed.
allowed_wording: The planned construction uses pre-event interval unions with censoring and ordering flags.
prohibited_wording: Revelio results show workers' prior experience.

proposed_manuscript_claim: Revelio identifies a 12-month occupational transition rate.
evidence_needed: Verified active risk set; continued observation versus attrition distinction
current_evidence: No Revelio data or retention fields have been verified.
allowed_wording: If ongoing observation is identifiable, the analysis will report a fixed-window observed transition rate; otherwise it reports entry composition.

proposed_manuscript_claim: LinkUp and Revelio jointly show demand and hiring at the same time.
evidence_needed: Text-effective dates and valid cross-source temporal alignment
current_evidence: LinkUp is mixed-vintage snapshot text while Revelio would contain dated events.
allowed_wording: The sources can be aligned on occupation/company/region structure and common support only.
prohibited_wording: Quarterly text requirements caused or coincided with quarterly hires.

proposed_manuscript_claim: Task controls resolve technology diffusion-stage confounding.
current_evidence: Kalyani et al. motivates that diffusion maturity may change average skills; task/occupation control is insufficient.
allowed_wording: Occupation/task controls describe composition; they do not identify diffusion stage.

proposed_manuscript_claim: AI productivity evidence implies hiring equalization.
evidence_needed: Recruiting or hiring outcome under comparable design
current_evidence: Brynjolfsson et al. supports within-firm productivity heterogeneity, not hiring outcomes.
allowed_wording: Productivity evidence motivates a question but does not establish recruiting equalization.
prohibited_wording: Lower-experience workers are more likely to be hired into AI jobs.

proposed_manuscript_claim: Task content is the appropriate conceptual comparison frame.
evidence_needed: Task framework and transparent measurement mapping
current_evidence: Autor-Levy-Murnane supports routine/nonroutine task framework; CPS uses fixed RTI; LinkUp task experience is currently NA.
allowed_wording: The paper uses task content as a conceptual frame and reports where it is directly unmeasured.
prohibited_wording: RTI or occupation labels measure an individual's realized task mix.
next_gate: Validated task measure in each source.

proposed_manuscript_claim: Old six tables establish data-engineering readiness.
evidence_needed: Run receipts, row conservation, key audits, numeric acceptance
current_evidence: 2026-10-03 report records completed T1-T6, 2464-shard aggregation, JOB_HASH audit, and numeric receipts.
allowed_wording: The old tables establish specified engineering and diagnostic facts.
prohibited_wording: The old tables validate the substantive experience or technology measurements.

evidence_needed: Authorized external model route; budget ceiling; permitted data scope; frozen request/model/schema
current_evidence: Local audit found only deterministic semantic batch infrastructure, no configured external model batch client/route/budget receipt for this task.
